text:
sqlpipe is a command line tool. The tool copies tables from a Postgres database to Amazon S3. sqlpipe converts each table to a Parquet file during the copy.

You can run sqlpipe from a terminal or from a script. The tool reads database connection details from a settings file or from environment variables. sqlpipe copies only the tables that you name. If you do not name any tables, sqlpipe copies all tables in the schema.

sqlpipe supports incremental sync. If you set a watermark column, sqlpipe copies only the rows that are new or changed since the last run. This mode reduces the number of rows that sqlpipe reads from Postgres and writes to S3.
